Module com.example.cab302_project
Package com.app.studysnap.services

Class AvatarService

java.lang.Object
com.app.studysnap.services.AvatarService
public final class AvatarService extends Object
Service for managing user avatar images.

Avatars are stored under a per-user filename in ~/.studysnap/avatars. The service can locate, save (replace), delete, and render avatars with a circular crop.

    • saveAvatar

      public Path saveAvatar(User user, File chosen) throws Exception
      Saves (or replaces) the user's avatar with the given image file. Existing avatar files for other extensions are removed.
      Parameters:
      user - the user who owns the avatar
      chosen - the source image file to copy
      Returns:
      the filesystem path of the saved avatar image
      Throws:
      Exception - if the directory cannot be created or the copy fails

    • applyUserAvatarOrDefault

      public void applyUserAvatarOrDefault(javafx.scene.image.ImageView view, User user, double sizePx, javafx.scene.image.Image fallbackDefault)
      Loads and applies the user's avatar to the given ImageView, falling back to fallbackDefault. The image is cropped to a square and displayed as a circle.
      Parameters:
      view - target ImageView
      user - the user whose avatar to load
      sizePx - target rendered size in pixels
      fallbackDefault - optional fallback image (can be null)
